title: leucanthemum corsicum
intro: Leucanthemum corsicum, commonly known as the Alpine Daisy, is a perennial plant belonging to the Asteraceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce the risk of certain diseases. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum corsicum include its ability to calm digestive discomfort, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues, making it a popular remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
